newsitem.title: JAPAN: Around 100 bln yen of CDs issued at 0.60 percent.
newsitem.headline: Around 100 bln yen of CDs issued at 0.60 percent.

text.p: Around 100 billion yen worth of three-month certificates of deposit (CDs) were issued at 0.60 percent in Tokyo on Wednesday, traders said.

It was the second consecutive day on which three-month CDs, the benchmark for the longer end of the money market, had been issued at 0.60 percent, the highest level in two months. Around 300 billion yen of CDs were issued on Tuesday. The previous issue of three-month CDs was on Friday at 0.58 percent.
There was talk in the market that the CDs issued on Tuesday were all issued by one bank, and some dealers said Wednesday's CDs may have been issued by that bank as well.
